product_overview: Ovlink is a secure URL shortener and link management platform that lets users create, manage, and analyze short links with features for password protection, expiration, custom domains, moderation, and redirect consent.
core_goals: Enable fast, secure short-link creation (under 10s) with optional alias, password, and expiration
Maintain a ≥99% redirect success rate and robust redirect consent/security controls
Provide actionable analytics and moderation tools for admins to manage abuse and reports
Support consistent UX across languages (AZ/TR/EN) and themes with required public policy/trust pages
Ensure platform-level security: session hardening, CSRF protection, rate limiting, and domain verification

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Allow new users to register with email and password and receive a verification code via email.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Register button -> POST /api/auth/register -> See 'verification email sent' confirmation -> Receive verification code email

Navigate to /register -> Fill email input field with an already-registered email -> Fill password input field -> Click Register button -> POST /api/auth/register -> See error 'email already registered' message

features.name: Email Verification
features.description: Verify a newly-registered user's email using a 6-digit code before allowing login.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter verification code -> Click verify button -> POST /api/auth/verify-email -> See 'email verified' confirmation -> Navigate to /login
Navigate to /register -> Enter incorrect verification code -> Click verify button -> POST /api/auth/verify-email -> See error 'invalid verification code' message

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate users using email/password credentials and create a session.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button -> POST /api/auth/login -> See dashboard at /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field with wrong password -> Click Login button -> POST /api/auth/login -> See error 'invalid credentials' message

features.name: Google OAuth Login
features.description: Sign in using Google OpenID Connect and create a session on success.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/google -> Click Google login button -> Authenticate with Google -> Receive callback at /auth/google/callback -> Session created -> Redirect to /dashboard
Navigate to /auth/google -> Click Google login button -> Cancel or deny consent on Google -> Return to /auth/google/callback with error -> See 'authentication failed' message on /login

features.name: URL Shortening
features.description: Create shortened URLs from long URLs with optional custom code, expiration, password protection, and tags.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Paste long URL into input -> Optionally set custom short code -> Optionally set expiration date -> Optionally set password protection -> Click shorten button -> POST /api/shorten -> See shortened URL in UI -> Click Copy shortened URL
Navigate to / -> Paste invalid URL into input -> Click shorten button -> POST /api/shorten -> See error 'invalid URL' message
Navigate to / -> Paste long URL -> Set custom short code that conflicts with an existing alias -> Click shorten button -> POST /api/shorten -> See error 'alias already in use' message
Unauthenticated user navigates to / -> Paste long URL -> Click shorten button repeatedly until limit reached -> POST /api/shorten -> See error 'guest limit exceeded' message

features.name: URL Click Analytics
features.description: Provide per-link statistics (click count, browser/OS, country, time series) to link owners.
user_flows: Navigate to /stats -> Select a short link from the list -> GET /api/stats/:short -> View click count charts -> View browser and OS breakdown -> View country breakdown -> Filter by date range
Navigate to /stats -> Select a short link owned by another user -> GET /api/stats/:short -> See error 'access denied' message

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Admin dashboard for managing users, links, reports, blocked domains, and site settings with RBAC and 2FA.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Fill admin credentials -> POST /admin/login -> See admin dashboard -> Click Users -> GET /admin/site-users -> Select a user -> Click 'Ban user' -> POST /admin/site-users -> See user status updated
Navigate to /admin -> Attempt access while unauthenticated or without admin role -> Redirect to /admin/login or see 'unauthorized' message -> Deny access to /admin/* endpoints

features.name: Custom Domains
features.description: Allow users to add and verify custom domains via DNS records to use when creating short links.
user_flows: Navigate to /account -> Click Add custom domain -> Fill domain input field -> Click Add -> POST /api/custom-domains -> See DNS verification instructions (TXT + CNAME/A/AAAA) -> Update DNS records at registrar -> Click Check verification status -> GET /api/custom-domains -> See domain status 'verified'
Navigate to /account -> Click Add custom domain -> Fill invalid domain format -> Click Add -> POST /api/custom-domains -> See error 'invalid domain' message
Navigate to /account -> Add custom domain -> Complete DNS steps incorrectly -> Click Check verification status -> GET /api/custom-domains -> See domain status 'verification failed'

features.name: Password Reset
features.description: Allow users to request a password reset email and set a new password via a secure reset link.
user_flows: Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter email address -> Click send reset link -> POST /api/forgot-password -> Receive password reset email -> Click reset link -> Navigate to /reset-password -> Enter new password -> Confirm new password -> Click submit -> POST /api/reset-password -> See 'password reset successful' message -> Navigate to /login
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter an unregistered email address -> Click send reset link -> POST /api/forgot-password -> See error 'email not found' message

features.name: QR Code Generation
features.description: Generate and allow download/view of QR codes for shortened URLs.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Click QR code button on a URL -> GET /api/qr/:short -> See QR code image -> Click Download QR code
Navigate to /dashboard -> Click QR code button for a non-existent or deleted short -> GET /api/qr/:short -> See error 'not found' message

features.name: Redirect Consent
features.description: Show a consent screen to visitors before redirecting, with an essential/analytics choice, countdown, and password verification if required.
user_flows: Open short link at /:shortCode -> See consent screen -> Choose consent mode 'analytics' -> Click proceed -> POST /api/redirect-consent -> Countdown completes (>=2s) -> Continue button unlocked -> Click Continue -> If link is not password-protected then redirect to destination URL

Open short link at /:shortCode -> See consent screen -> Choose consent mode 'essential only' -> Click proceed -> POST /api/redirect-consent -> Click Continue before 2s -> Continue button remains disabled -> Wait 2s -> Click Continue -> Redirect occurs

Open short link at /:shortCode for a password-protected link -> See consent screen -> Choose a mode -> Click proceed -> POST /api/redirect-consent -> Navigate to /proceed/:short -> Enter password -> POST /verify/:short -> If password incorrect see error 'invalid password' and remain on /proceed/:short
